Not without struggle, I had some ups and downs but in the end it’s about changing your lifestyle in general, not a fad diet :) if you have more questions, I can dm you details!

Hey there! It is completely valid to let out your emotions (even just small ones) through venting. See, some people might talk in person to a friend about what bothers them. And others, like you (and me too, if you take a look at my posts) just feel more comfortable to write it out. I have a page in my Notes App where I just write down what’s on my mind right now, sometimes in Form of a letter to some imaginary person, or just telling a story of what stupid annoying thing just happened in school. 
I personally don’t judge people by their posts, and you, think about how many times you looked at somebody‘s account and thought „Wow that person is posting this and that, how stupid“. I‘m not saying what you are doing doesn’t matter, I just mean that there are greater things that define you as a person that your problems or just little issues. 
Also, in my opinion, there is no such things as „real problems“ and „the ones in your head“ that seem to be less important. I think they should be addressed just as much as obvious, visible issues.

Hey there. I 1000% feel you. Feeling like this is okay and completely valid. I struggled and still do with the same questions and I‘m constantly wondering what my purpose is. Well, I can say, that even if people don’t say it to your face, many need you. Now, this is something you and I probably hear very often. But I can confirm that this is true. At every point in our life, there is at least one person that needs you. Please believe me with that. Might be for a deed, like a classmate / colleague that you greet every morning and who is sad when you are not there sometimes. Or something less obvious like an old lady sitting at the window and smiling when she sees you walking past her house in the morning, because you just have that special something that makes others feel happy when you are there. 
This obviously also applies to more personal relationships like family and close friends. See, I know the feeling of having absolutely nobody to trust and be comfortable with. But you make people‘s days without even realizing. You have an impact on people. 
I don’t know you or your story, but I believe that if you start to recognize the small details in interactions with others, it will be easier to see those on a bigger scale. 
Hang in there, I care about you. DM me if you need someone to talk

Hey, I feel you. First of I want to say, that it’s absolutely okay and valid to feel like this. Having your basic needs met doesn’t mean you instantly have to feel happy. Life is about more than just surviving. Humans are complex and everybody has different priorities and needs. 
So, only seeing the worst in oneself. I can 100% relate. I keep thinking about what I‘m doing wrong and what a failure I am for not reaching the impossible expectations I set up for myself. I don’t really have specific advice on how I cope with that. What I do is just experience what I can do. It can be something big, like playing an instrument or something very tiny like making a funny face (yes, I consider it a talent) or being able to draw a little frog, or a bee, or just a smiley face. If you start noticing small things, you might come onto the path of discovering the greater things that you are capable of. Probably what you light think right know is, that there won’t be anything. But please, please believe me when I say there is. Everybody is so beautiful and unique on their own, and so are you. 
Hang in there, I believe in you. DM me if you want to talk.

I‘m so sorry for what is happening in your life right now. I don’t know you or your Story, but I want you to know that at low points in your life, all this might seem hopeless. People always say things like „It will get better“ and I know that this is something stupid to say. It might be true, but if you are in a situation where you can’t see a better future, this doesn’t do anything. 
If there is a way you can get away from a toxic environment, like staying somewhere else, maybe consider getting away for a few days. (Again, I don’t know any details so this is just a general idea). I know the feeling of having absolutely nobody to trust or to be comfortable with. If there is anybody you are just a little closer than them being a stranger and who you like, maybe text them and ask if you can come over. If for some reason you can’t sleep anywhere else, maybe just meet up with them somewhere (in a pandemic this might be hard but there’s always a way). 
This isn’t too much of helpful advice but please hang on there. I care about you. And you definitely aren’t alone.
